headline: National AI Literacy Initiative: one million learners
digest: ISED and Amii launched the National AI Literacy Initiative, which targets up to one million post-secondary students and 50,000+ K-12 educators through free courses, plus an 'Essentials for Canadians' stream. Actua welcomed it. A CSPC editorial tested AI for All against Indigenous sovereignty over land, energy and water. Raspberry Pi expanded Experience AI resources, and SRI called for independent testing of frontier models.
